title: Tafiyar Ruhun da Aka Ɗauka
intro: A lokacin da al'adun al'umma suka yi ƙarfi, wani mutum na musamman ya sami babban sauyi a cikin gida mai albarka. Labarinsu, wanda aka nuna shi da alaƙar ƙauna da kuma umarnin Allah, yana nuna karya tsoffin al'adu da kuma kafa sabbin ƙa'idodi masu adalci. Wannan labarin yana nuna muhimmancin gaskiya fiye da al'ada da kuma hikimar da ke cikin umarnin Allah.
clues: Na taɓa zama fursuna, amma ta hanyar tsarin Allah, na sami sabon gida da iyali.
Na ji daɗin sosai har lokacin da aka ba ni zaɓi tsakanin iyalina na asali da kuma mai kula da ni, na zaɓi in ci gaba da zama tare da na biyun.
Sunana yana da alaƙa da mai kula da ni da aka ɗauke ni, al'adar da ta zama ruwan dare a cikin al'ummata.
Ni kaɗai ne abokin Annabi na ƙarshe wanda Allah ya ambaci sunansa a cikin Alƙur'ani.
Na auri wata mace mai daraja wacce 'yar uwan ​​Annabi ce, amma aurenmu bai daɗe ba.
Bayan saki na, Allah da kansa ya hukunta cewa tsohuwar matata za ta auri Annabi, ta haka ne ya soke wata tsohuwar al'ada game da ɗaukar yara.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
